issues.body: The module claims SortMergeCost reports what a real deployment pays and says each adjacency equality contributes its full bit-decomposition circuit. However, scan_mults is only the delta of ShamirDealer::mult_count, which explicitly counts degree_reduce rounds and excludes masked-product opens used by Rabbit solved-bit and zero-test/range-proof machinery. SortMergeCost::opens counts only padded-reveal opens, so the omitted interactive Rabbit work is not reported anywhere. The focused test merely proves scan_mults exceeds the equality-fold floor; it does not account for or assert the full decomposition/range-proof communication. Thus the public modeled communication cost remains materially incomplete, despite no longer treating equality as one multiplication.
issues.fix_hint: Either add explicit counters/costs for every interactive operation used by Rabbit decomposition and range proofs (including masked-product opens) and include them in SortMergeCost, with a focused exact/derived test, or narrow all module/API claims so the structure is clearly only a degree-reduction-round counter rather than what a real deployment pays. If narrowing, expose the omitted scan opens separately so the communication model is complete.
issues.title: Cost report still omits interactive Rabbit work from the segmented scan

verdict.summary: Round 5 improves the implementation by replacing the one-per-equality tally with a dealer counter, but it does not fully resolve round 4's major cost-honesty finding. The public module still says SortMergeCost reports what a real deployment pays, while scan_mults now counts only successful degree_reduce rounds and deliberately omits the Rabbit decomposition/range-proof masked-product opens. Those interactive operations are part of every adjacency equality, yet they are neither included in scan_mults nor represented by another scan-cost field (opens counts only padded reveal). The new test validates only a lower bound on the narrowed counter, so it cannot establish the advertised full communication cost. This is materially the same major finding at the same severity, so progress is stagnant.
